caption: The drawing features three thick, black, hand-drawn letters—“J”, “C”, and “R”—on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The “J” is centrally located and vertically oriented, with the “R” overlapping and positioned above the top of the “J” so that the vertical stem of the “R” aligns with the stem of the “J.” The “C” is a large, open curve that sweeps around the left side of the “J,” partially encircling it from the lower left to the upper middle. The lines are bold and solid with consistent thickness. There are no additional objects, shading, or colors other than the black letters on the light background. In the bottom right corner, a small number “261” appears.
title: Cattle Brand
